notes.title: Death: The Ascension is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Well, you may ask yourself why [b]buy this game[/b]?

Here is a dialogue between me and "you"

[b]Me[/b]: Is new.

[b]You[/b]: What is so new in it? 

[b]Me[/b]: Well, EVERYTHING.

[b]You[/b]: It is fun, tho?

[b]Me[/b]: Look, I tried to reinvent the wheel here so I say at best I have a 50%  good and 50% bad or 10% good to 90% at worst.

[b]You[/b]: That sounds awful.

[b]Me[/b]: I create this game for people that got bored with the generic types of game, something refereeing something new, something you have nothing to compare with.

[b]You[/b]:

notes.title: Death: The Ascension Demo is live on Steam NOW
notes.content:
The demo is pretty short but I can guarantee you never play something like this before [b]so give it a try[/b] !!
